2607.18006.title: MADA-RL: Multi-Agent Debate-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Parameter-Efficient Reasoning in Compact Models
2607.18006.paper_summary: Large language models achieve strong reasoning performance, but often at prohibitive training cost - a challenge that is especially acute for compact models ($\leq 4 \, \mathrm{B}$ parameters) trained under limited budgets. We introduce MADA-RL, a post-training framework that specializes compact models into generator and critic roles and trains them with a debate-aware learning signal, fine-tuning only a small subset of parameters via LoRA adapters. Our central contribution is a counterfactual critic advantage: a dynamic, role-conditioned baseline that redefines the critic's advantage as its reward minus the generator ensemble's per-instance accuracy. This explicitly optimizes critics to improve over generator consensus rather than to merely reproduce a correct answer, yielding more targeted credit assignment than static mean-reward normalization. At deployment, the specialized agents are composed in a lightweight multi-round protocol. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MADA-RL raises the accuracy of the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B model from $39.9 \, \%$ to $41.9 \, \%$ ($+2.0$ points, $p < 0.001$) using $16$ times fewer trainable parameters than fully fine-tuned baselines, placing it on the accuracy-trainable-parameter Pareto front. It approaches, but does not surpass, the strongest baselines (DeepScaleR, STILL-3), which are trained on substantially larger datasets; we analyse this gap and the associated inference-time cost directly. A controlled study isolates the source of MADA-RL's gains: the counterfactual advantage produces the highest critic improvement rate of any model evaluated, indicating that trained critics learn to correct generator errors rather than to imitate them.
2607.18006.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在推理性能上表現出色，但通常需要高昂的訓練成本——這對於在有限預算下訓練的緊湊模型（$\leq 4 \, \mathrm{B}$ 參數）來說，尤其是一個挑戰。我們提出了 MADA-RL，一個後訓練框架，將緊湊模型專門化為生成器和批評者角色，並通過辯論意識學習信號進行訓練，僅通過 LoRA 適配器微調一小部分參數。我們的核心貢獻是一個反事實批評者優勢：一個動態的、角色條件的基準，將批評者的優勢重新定義為其獎勵減去生成器集成的每實例準確率。這明確優化了批評者，使其在生成器共識上有所改進，而不僅僅是重現正確答案，從而比靜態均值獎勵歸一化提供了更具針對性的信用分配。在部署時，專門化的代理以輕量級的多輪協議組合。在五個數學推理基準測試中，MADA-RL 將 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 模型的準確率從 $39.9 \, \%$ 提高到 $41.9 \, \%$ （$+2.0$ 點，$p < 0.001$），使用的可訓練參數比完全微調的基準少 $16$ 倍，將其置於準確率-可訓練參數的帕累托前沿。它接近但未超過最強基準（DeepScaleR, STILL-3），這些基準是在大得多的數據集上訓練的；我們直接分析這一差距及其相關的推理時間成本。一項控制研究隔離了 MADA-RL 增益的來源：反事實優勢產生了評估的任何模型中最高的批評者改善率，表明訓練的批評者學會了糾正生成器錯誤，而不是模仿它們。
